newsitem.title: USA: Geotek finalizes German network merger.
newsitem.headline: Geotek finalizes German network merger.

text.p: Geotek Communications Inc on Monday said it finalized an agreement made in April to merge its mobile radio network in Germany with those of RWE AG's Telliance unit.

The networks being merged, Geotek's Regionet and RWE TERRAFON Bundelfunk are analog voice and data services which have 33,000 business fleet users in Germany. The firms will have a 50 percent stake each in the network joint venture.
The two companies intend to press ahead with their plans to build a digital network to be available from early 1998, which will use Geotek's frequency-hopping technology.
The new digital service will provide mobile telephone, two-way radio, vehicle location, messaging and data dispatch, Geotek said. No financial details were given.
The agreement is subject to German regulatory approval. -- Nick Louth, New York Newsroom 212 859 1610
